findings.evidence: Good paint hid things; that was what it was for.
findings.diagnosis: The close-third narrator states the theme as a mini-thesis and primes the reader that the fresh paint conceals a defect, a few lines before the hand finds the give; the concrete beat before it already carries the wariness.

findings.evidence: where the wood had given and would give again.
findings.diagnosis: 'would give again' reaches past the physical fact for resonance; the image is complete at the thumb on the soft of the plank.
The garboard is a single strake running fore-and-aft; moving aft you stay on the same plank, so 'three planks aft' does not parse geometrically.
